title: Archetype suite v0.1 (ADR-013 §4)
description: The Gate's policy: a versioned suite of application personas, each carrying the estate evidence that justifies it. A suite with zero personas is representable — that is the state until the design pass authors content. An archetype without coverage evidence is not representable: a persona nobody can audit for ossification is the MP-32 trap.

archetype_suite.description: Reader dispatch key. An unknown version MUST raise, never fall back (MP-02).

suite_version.description: Human suite version (v0, v1, …). Identity of the suite node; the digest is of content, not of this label.

archetypes.description: Empty is valid. Each entry, when present, MUST carry coverage evidence.

workload_classes.description: Which production workload classes this persona represents, and at what count. Stored evidence — not derived from the persona's name.

count.description: How many production workloads of this class the persona stands for.

basis.description: How the counts were measured. Without a basis the numbers are a claim, not evidence (ADR-013 §4, MP-32).

name.description: Stable persona id. The design pass names these; this schema does not invent them.

checks.description: Test-suite definition this persona exercises (ADR-013 §4). Optional until the design pass fills it.
